This file documents the adapters resource at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =adapters=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

* Commands

** =list=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: 04CE9424-B744-5EAD-ADA6-E76EF91B830A
:END:

Reads one page of the collection. Nothing addresses it but the caller's tenant, so it is the read that shows what exists.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
adapters list [--offset <n>] [--limit <n>] [--order <field>] [--desc]
#+end_example

It is addressed at =marketdata.v1.adapters.list=.

#+name: adapters-list
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle adapters-list.ores :exports none
adapters list --limit 1
#+end_src

** =get=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: B29D95F2-D6B4-59B8-8C80-915CD4203D3F
:END:

Reads the one row its key addresses. A key states every identifying column, so a partial key is refused rather than answered with an arbitrary row.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
adapters get <code>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =marketdata.v1.adapters.get=.

#+name: adapters-get
#+begin_src ores-shell :tangle adapters-get.ores :exports none
adapters get __none__
#+end_src
